description: Connects a domain (apex and www) to a Storly online store. The apex A record and the www CNAME point to Storly's storefront origin, and a TXT record at _storly-verification proves which Storly store the domain owner approved. No other records (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) are created or changed.
variableDescription: verifytoken: Storly's per-domain ownership token (32 lowercase hex characters), generated by Storly for the store connecting this domain and covered by the request signature.
